title: Brazilian Coconut Sweet Treats
description: A delicious dessert inspired by Brazilian cuisine, made with sweet coconut cookies and crispy sweet treats.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a medium bowl, whisk together sugar, egg, and vanilla extract.
Add shredded coconut and mix until well combined.
Roll coconut mixture into small balls, about 1 inch in diameter.
Place balls onto prepared baking sheet, leaving about 1 inch of space between each.
Bake for 18-20 minutes, or until lightly golden brown.
Allow cookies to cool completely on the baking sheet.
Dip cooled cookies into sweetened condensed milk, coating completely.
Place dipped cookies on a wire rack to set for at least 30 minutes.
